verdict.rationale: Mastra documents running agents and workflows as a server or as standalone endpoints, with no Studio UI required. It also offers recurring schedules, repeatable evals that score runs before changes reach production, and built-in deployers that automate deployment, which together support unattended automation. However, no evidence explicitly documents a CI integration or a headless CLI mode, so CI use is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline docs (e.g. running evals or workflows in GitHub Actions), a documented non-interactive CLI or exit-code behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
Score agent runs against repeatable checks before changes reach production.
Mastra includes optional built-in deployers for Vercel, Netlify and Cloudflare to automate the deployment process.
